description: Computes a line-by-line diff between two text versions on top of the shared Tempo.Blazor.Diff.TextDiff engine; useful for IFileVersioningHook implementations that version text content. CRLF is normalized to LF before the comparison. Above the engine's DefaultMaxTokens / DefaultMaxCells limits the comparison degrades to one block of removed lines followed by one block of added lines covering the whole text.

members.name: Compute
members.description: Produces added/removed/unchanged lines describing the change from old to new text, with 1-based line numbers in both versions and a replacement emitted as removed-then-added.
